gapsIdentified: Live Chat separation: Live chat conversation sessions (type = 'LIVE_CHAT') must be distinct from support tickets (type = 'TICKET'), with support for escalating LIVE_CHAT -> TICKET with full conversation reference

State Machine: Enforce strict transitions: OPEN -> IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS -> WAITING_FOR_USER, WAITING_FOR_USER -> IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED, RESOLVED -> CLOSED, REOPENED
Internal Notes isolation: Absolute backend isolation guaranteeing INTERNAL_NOTE is never returned to user endpoints or broadcasted on user sockets
Admin Live Chat queue: Dedicated /admin/support tab with WAITING, ACTIVE, UNASSIGNED, MY CHATS, Accept Chat, Escalate Chat to Ticket, and real-time live chat interaction
Related Records Verification: Backend verification for related entity IDs (Bet, Deposit, Withdrawal, KYC, Referral) ensuring existence and user ownership
Browser Push Notifications: Wire ticket reply and live chat events to webPushEngine and user_push_subscriptions
